stories.headline: CODELCO fires three executives for concealing information about 2023 El Teniente accident
stories.summary: State copper company CODELCO dismissed three senior executives, including the VP of Operations, after an internal audit revealed they concealed technical information from mining regulators about a 2023 rock burst incident at El Teniente mine. The cover-up preceded the deadly July 2025 accident that killed six workers.
